propositions: Cloud transport mutations lack explicit enumeration and per-layer 429 behaviour classification across four distinct retry seams: bare urllib.request.urlopen, pooled REST via _rest_urlopen_with_retry, ACLI subprocess with rate-limit backoff, and dispatch-wrapped _call_with_retry.

Cloud has no config-validation tier equivalent to DC's non-HTTPS rejection, credentials-required assertion, and per-deployment resolved-status configuration — creating asymmetry in resilience coverage and silent-failure risks.

Cloud probe.RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES is hardcoded without runtime-config hook; DC threads resolved_statuses from settings, leaving unanswered whether Cloud deployments with non-standard workflow state names require config parity or hit degradation.
Cloud's outbound_assignee._USER_SEARCH_METHODS degradation path on DC (none of the three aliases exist) is unasserted, risking accidental rename without detection.
